rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Performs deterministic dependency graph analysis using tree-sitter parsing to map every symbol, import, and export relationship across a codebase. Provides impact analysis showing the exact blast radius of proposed changes—renames, moves, and deletes—before they are implemented, along with multi-dimensional architecture health scoring. Additional capabilities include dead code detection with confidence scoring, graph-aware security scanning across multiple vulnerability categories, and interactive arc diagram visualization of the codebase dependency structure.
